title: Metadata on an aniframe
text: 2D image-derived data ’s annoying convention split: image / video tooling uses top-left corner (0, 0) (y increases downward), plotting maths uses bottom-left corner (y increases upward). aniframe records one data uses origin field, permitted values c("bottom_left", "top_left"). set_origin() actual flip change convention. needs frame height compute y_new = y_height - y_old, y_height must set first. Readers populate automatically; manually-constructed aniframe objects, as_aniframe() falls back max(y), set_y_height() lets override true value.
code: img <- aniframe(   individual = 1L, time = 1:4,   x = c(0, 10, 20, 30),   y = c(50, 100, 150, 200) ) |>   set_y_height(1080)  img$y #> [1]  50 100 150 200 img <- set_origin(img, "top_left") img$y # reflected: 1080 - original y #> [1] 1030  980  930  880

title: Metadata on an aniframe
text: Spatial, temporal, angular units setter. Conversions standard units automatic; conversions unknown / frame / px units require explicit calibration factor (, time, sampling_rate). title: The aniframe data structure
text: Every row aniframe answers three questions: combination identity temporal columns forms composite key uniquely identifies row; spatial columns row records entity timepoint. aniframe stores columns play role metadata, downstream code can introspect: readers populate source data, can override constructing manually. default, as_aniframe() recognises c("model", "individual", "track", "keypoint") identity columns c("session", "trial", "time") temporal columns. title: The aniframe data structure
text: set spatial columns determines coordinate system. aniframe recognises four families: number Cartesian columns picks dimensionality (cartesian_1d, cartesian_2d, cartesian_3d): rho + phi indicates polar-family system; third column () distinguishes variant: programmatic checks, every coordinate system is_<system>() predicate (returns logical) ensure_is_<system>() guard (errors otherwise):

title: aniframe 0.5.0 (2026-05-04)
text: set_unit_angle() now automatically converts spatial angular columns phi theta whenever present, polar / cylindrical / spherical coordinates stay consistent declared unit_angle. Previously columns assumed radians affected set_unit_angle(). argument order also rearranged set_unit_angle(data, to_unit, cols = NULL) (matching set_unit_time()), cols now optional — pass additional non-spatial angular columns (#21). tbl_sum.aniframe() (print summary) now driven variables_what variables_when metadata fields rather hard-coding individual / keypoint / session / trial. Custom identity temporal variables (e.g. track, model) appear automatically, rows omitted column absent — fixing “Unknown uninitialised column: individual” warning emitted single-track readers (#51). print.aniframe_metadata() renders single block (leading newline, blank lines entries), field names types now padded fixed widths values line vertically (similar str()). [levels: ...] line factor fields indented match value column (#48). filename metadata field now explicitly supports character vector length >= 1, readers load multiple source files (e.g. aniread::read_trackball()) (#34).
